page.layout: One page of text. At the head: running title "PARS SECVNDA." left of centre and page number "171" at the top right. Below them, two coin medallions side by side, with their legends. Then one paragraph beginning "BALDVINVS", then one paragraph beginning "HENRICVS". Below the text, a decorative ornament without printed text. No margin notes.

BALDVINVS, Flandriæ Comes, ab omni milite, &
exercitu,Flandrensi scilicet,Montisferratensi,Allobrogum &
Venetorum , Imperator Constantinopolitanus creatur post
Alexium iuniorem anno mundi 5162. à Christo nato 1200.
hac conditione vt si ex Francis designaretur Imperator,Vene-
ti Patriarcham darent: quod & euenit. Balduinus cuncta
præter Adrianopolim recepit:in qua imperauit Theodorus,. Ale-
xij Imperatoris pessimi gener, quam & nomine dotis accepit.
Cum Franci eam obsiderent ac prope expugnarent,captus
& mortuus est Balduinus,qui annum imperio vix præfuerat. Vi-
de Egna.lib.2.Ro.prin.& Cosm.Mun.lib.4.
HENRICVS Balduini frater,Imperator post eius mor-
tem creatur, anno mundi 5163.à Christo nato 1201. Hic ex-
pugnationem Adrianopolitanam persequitur, ac repetit: sed
irruentibus Saracenis, obsidionem soluit: Constantinopolim
rediit, quam & munit. Fœdere cum Valachis firmato, & filia
Ducis eorum in vxorem ducta,domi,forisque cum prudenter
se Henricus gereret, Gulielmum Bonifacij filium, Regem
Thessaliæ designat. mox moriens, Iolantem filiam, Petro Al-
tisiodorensi nuptam, hæredem relinquit,anno imperij 13. Vi-
de vt supra.

page.notes: The two medallion legends are only partly legible. The left coin reads "FLANDR." and "BALDVINVS". The right coin reads "HENRI" and, on the left, "CVSA" with the last letter doubtful, probably the end of HENRICVS. The decorative ornament below the text carries no printed words and is not transcribed. The text is printed with the spelling "vt", "vxorem" and "ducta", which I have kept as printed in the transcription. The printed "vt" and "vxorem" may need normalising to ut and uxorem under the house rules.
